text:
sam_support: Escalation: Solara (trial acct 4021) ingest -> embedding errors for 16h, intermittent 502s and low-quality vectors. Ticket #22011. Requeue didn't help. Renewal flagged in ~45d. Need CS to lead comms and run prioritized onboarding checklist.

harper_cs: On it. @lee_se can you triage root cause? We should offer a same-day sync and outline a comms plan.

lee_se: Quick look: client retry storm + large batch sizes causing worker overload and cache pressure. Short fix: drop batch_size=6, enable tenant prefix caching, and pause parallel reingests. I'll validate in staging.

sam_support: Canary with batch_size=6 spinning now. Customer requests 2pm local call. Can CS lead?

mira_onboard: I can join for runbook. Checklist: capture failing UUIDs, confirm dedupe, prepare 1hr reingest slot, rollback steps, and post-mortem notes for renewal team. Sam paste a few UUIDs?

sam_support: Added samples to ticket: uuid a7d9..., 3f1b... Also saw duplicate sends when timeouts occur.

harper_cs: Drafting message: apologize, explain mitigation, request 1hr reingest window, promise updates every 90m until resolved. I'll handle customer invite + follow-ups. Looping in @jamie_revops for renewal watch.

jamie_revops: Thanks — I'll add to renewal risk board and prep contract outreach if needed.

lee_se: Staging results: 88% fewer timeouts, similarity histograms stable. Promoting canary to limited prod in 30m, full roll + reingest if stable.

sam_support: Customer agreed to 2pm call and reingest window. Invite sent. Updating ticket with KPIs.

harper_cs: Will lead call and capture feedback; we'll open an eval to validate embeddings post-reingest and update renewal playbook.
